name: @pipeworx/mcp-flashalpha

tools.name: flashalpha_gex
tools.description: Get options gamma exposure (GEX) by strike for an underlying — net GEX, gamma flip, and per-strike call/put gamma. Useful for reading dealer positioning and likely support/resistance. Example: flashalpha_gex({ symbol: "SPY", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: FlashAlpha API key (get one at https://flashalpha.com/pricing)

tools.name: flashalpha_levels
tools.description: Get key options-derived levels for an underlying — gamma flip level, call wall, and put wall. These act as magnet / support / resistance levels driven by dealer gamma. Example: flashalpha_levels({ symbol: "SPY", _apiKey: "your-key" })

tools.name: flashalpha_iv
tools.description: Get an implied-volatility summary for a stock — IV rank and IV percentile (plus current/underlying IV where available). Use to gauge whether options are relatively cheap or expensive. Example: flashalpha_iv({ symbol: "AAPL", _apiKey: "your-key" })

tools.name: flashalpha_greeks
tools.description: Black-Scholes (BSM) option greeks calculator — pass spot, strike, days-to-expiry, volatility and option type to get delta, gamma, theta, vega (and higher-order greeks where returned). Example: flashalpha_greeks({ spot: 100, strike: 105, dte: 30, vol: 0.25, type: "call", _apiKey: "your-key" })

vol.description: Implied volatility as a decimal (sigma), e.g. 0.25 for 25%

rate.description: Risk-free interest rate as a decimal (optional), e.g. 0.05 for 5%

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-flashalpha forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the flashalpha pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
